# Open Thread 455

**Date:** 2026-10-13T00:19:32.000Z

---

View this post on the web at https://www.astralcodexten.com/p/open-thread-455

This is the weekly visible open thread. Post about anything you want, ask random questions, whatever. ACX has an unofficial subreddit [ https://substack.com/redirect/eb7501e9-541b-4f7f-9e47-e52f9c01ef77?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Discord [ https://substack.com/redirect/5d5c6fd7-4132-4ea4-a6e9-160a63026360?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and bulletin board [ https://substack.com/redirect/132fd467-db46-4bb1-9fea-23d2c0003386?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and in-person meetups around the world [ https://substack.com/redirect/062c4dc4-cd88-40a0-9151-2fb3aaae2fa2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Most content is free, some is subscriber only; you can subscribe here [ https://substack.com/redirect/99035641-d2a4-4ca7-bbe0-f1c04bc41ded?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Also:
1: Meetup updates: Stanford EA is changing from October 13 to October 25. 
2: ACX grantee Legal Impact For Chickens [ https://substack.com/redirect/2447d875-caab-4292-bb24-08e916c90220?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] announces that they have a 1:1 donation match available for donations above $25 until October 31.
3: AI alignment research group AFFINE is holding another seminar/full-time residency January 4 - 29 in Portugal. Attendance is free, travel costs are covered, and there is a $1000 stipend. More info / apply here [ https://substack.com/redirect/b47db961-fc8e-4015-b8cb-92285f5a529b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. AFFINE works within the “agent foundations” paradigm; I recommend having a good understanding of the pros and cons of doing research within this school before applying.
